items.title: Urbie Green interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: And my son, Jesse, they’re both about the same age, about 23 now I think.

ctx.x: Amazing young player. And my son, Jesse, they’re both about the same age, about 23 now I think. And boy, he knows more about jazz history than I do and he goes right from the beginning to what’s happening now and there’s somewhere in there Chris has, his own thing has come out too you know. If you haven’t heard him, it’d be interesting to hear him. Well there’s an example. Well he went right to New York I guess, got a scholarship to the New School there, and he stayed there for a while, then he went to Manhattan…

It’s unfortunate that the opportunities as far as the big band playing you know, are not nearly as plentiful as they used to be. I think there’s probably a lot more talented people out there that come out of schools and they’re scrambling for ways to show what they know and to go to the next level.
